name: DENT 5430
title: Advanced Oral Histology
description: Oral tissues, their embryological orgin, histology and function.  Structure of developing teeth, alveolar bone, temporo-mandibular joint, oral mucosa, gingiva and salivary glands.  Lecture, slide review, and student-led discussions of papers from the research literature.
requirement_description: Open only to current UConn Health Dental Residents in the combined Certificate/Master of Dental Science Program.
